subject.title: fix(doctor): bound legacy sessions.json reads during SQLite inspect

question: Should Doctor continue to support migration of valid legacy `sessions.json` files above 16 MiB, and if so should it use a bounded streaming path rather than permanently fail closed?
rationale: The proposed 16 MiB ceiling changes the upgrade contract for persistent user session history; code review cannot determine whether loss of the migration path is an acceptable product policy.

options.title: Preserve oversized-store migration
options.body: Implement a bounded streaming or otherwise memory-safe migration path so valid legacy session history remains migratable.

options.title: Accept the support ceiling
options.body: Keep the 16 MiB fail-closed boundary only after explicitly accepting the manual backup/prune/removal recovery path for existing users.

recommendation.title: Preserve oversized-store migration
recommendation.body: Implement a bounded streaming or otherwise memory-safe migration path so valid legacy session history remains migratable.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history could not be inspected in the available read-only execution environment, so no individual owner can be identified safely.
